title: Light Propagation through Space-Time Non-Markovian Random Media
summary: Here, we introduce a stochastic partial differential equation (SPDE) formulation driven by temporally correlated noise to describe light propagation beyond the standard Markov approximation. By representing the squared refractive index fluctuations as a random field with explicit long-range temporal correlations, we demonstrate that the propagation dynamics map exactly onto the hyperbolic Anderson model.
